title: 第三四三章 元婴会第三四二章 天荒来客
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 李水生心道：看来天荒那三位道君也发现问题不对劲了，现在可比玄云之地的元婴道君急多了。
此时此刻，李水生终于明白，太一魔君说的时机是什么时候了。
“寒道友，你看将议事处设在龙宫可好？”
“至于时间，就定在十二月初七。”
寒千尺心领神会道：“此地极妙，看来大真君早有预料，那我便回去传信了。”
李水生收拾了一番衣装，身穿白菟和沈奕君做的麒麟道袍，一个踏步，跨越千里。
如今的他，道法深厚，大道感悟再上一层楼，即便是没有天鹏分身，也能做到一步千里。
正在批阅奏折的龙骧，忽然感受到前面出现了一人，他抬头，赫然是李水生！
“姑父！”
李水生道：“安排一下，我要见龙君，还有，秘密准备一个最高级别的龙宫，我要用。”
龙骧连忙带着李水生前去拜会龙君。
龙君大殿。
金碧辉煌的龙宫之中，中间是一具栩栩如生的真龙雕像。
龙骧上香，“玄冥大真君前来，敬请龙君显灵！”
那雕像睁开双眼，阴阳双瞳看向李水生。
“玄冥！万华、天星、拓天要杀老龙，是也不是？”
毕竟是四海之主，不可能没有丝毫察觉。
李水生挥袖，展露白菟的还魂棺，白菟安静地躺在其中，美若神女。
“我也是龙宫的人，万华道君，天星道君，拓天道君若是要杀龙君，玄冥当身死于龙君之前！”
那真龙雕像之后涌现出一道水流，老迈的龙君自雕像之后走出。
“若是他人，老龙是不信的。”
“既然是玄冥，老龙便将这一条性命，托付给你了。”
“老龙，真身参会！”
龙君坐在一旁，李水生看向龙骧，“还不快快去布置隐秘龙宫？”
“小心些，可能会有很多元婴道君前来。”
龙骧岂敢怠慢，连忙下去了。
来到龙骧精心布置的龙宫之中，外面碧波悠悠，内里温暖如春。
中间一方长桌，摆着九张座椅。
龙君就坐在一旁，仿佛等死的老人。
李水生也不避开龙君，直接激活千里传音符，“太一前辈，天荒那边来信了，要在龙宫议事。”
太一魔君骂道：“真是三个废物，这得查了有百年才发现吧？”
content_en:
Li Shuisheng thought to himself: It seems that the three Dao Lords of Tianhuang have also discovered that something is wrong. They are now much more anxious than the Yuanying Dao Lords of Xuanyun Land.
At this moment, Li Shuisheng finally understood when the Taiyi Demon Lord was talking about.
"Friend Dao Han, do you think it would be good to set up the meeting place in the Dragon Palace?"
"As for the time, it will be on the seventh day of December."
Han Qianchi understood it and said: "This place is wonderful. It seems that the Great True Lord has already predicted it, so I will go back to deliver the message."
Li Shuisheng packed up his clothes, wore a unicorn Taoist robe made by Bai Tu and Shen Yijun, and crossed a thousand miles with one step.
Nowadays, his Taoism is profound, and his understanding of the Tao has reached a new level. Even without the Tianpeng clone, he can still achieve a thousand miles in one step.
Long Xiang, who was reviewing the memorial, suddenly felt a person appear in front of him. He looked up and it was Li Shuisheng!
"Uncle!"
Li Shuisheng said: "Let's make some arrangements. I want to see the Dragon Lord. Also, secretly prepare a Dragon Palace of the highest level for me to use."
Long Xiang quickly took Li Shuisheng to visit Long Jun.
Dragon Lord Hall.
In the center of the magnificent Dragon Palace is a lifelike statue of a real dragon.
Long Xiang offered incense and said, "The Great True Lord Xuan Ming is here, and I sincerely invite Lord Dragon to show his spirit!"
The statue opened its eyes and looked at Li Shuisheng with its yin and yang pupils.
"Xuan Ming! Wanhua, Tianxing, and Tuotian want to kill the old dragon, right?"
After all, he is the Lord of the Four Seas, so he cannot be unaware of it.
Li Shuisheng waved his sleeves and revealed Bai Tu's resurrected coffin. Bai Tu was lying quietly in it, as beautiful as a goddess.
"I am also a member of the Dragon Palace. Taoist Wanhua, Taoist Tianxing, and Taoist Tuotian. If they want to kill Dragon Lord, Xuan Ming will die before Dragon Lord!"
A stream of water emerged from behind the real dragon statue, and the old dragon king walked out from behind the statue.
"If it were anyone else, Lao Long wouldn't believe it."
"Since it is Xuan Ming, Old Long will entrust this life to you."
"Old Long, come to the meeting in person!"
Long Jun sat aside, and Li Shuisheng looked at Long Xiang, "Why don't you quickly go and decorate the secret dragon palace?"
"Be careful, there may be many Nascent Soul Dao Lords coming."
Long Xiang didn't dare to neglect and went down quickly.
Coming to the Dragon Palace carefully decorated by Long Xiang, the blue waves are leisurely outside and warm as spring inside.
There is a long table in the middle with nine seats.
Lord Long was sitting aside, like an old man waiting to die.
Li Shuisheng did not avoid Long Jun, and directly activated the Thousand Miles Transmission Talisman, "Senior Taiyi, there is a letter from Tianhuang, and they want to discuss matters in the Dragon Palace."
Demon Lord Taiyi scolded: "What three wastes? It took a hundred years of investigation to find out, right?"
